This document outlines the equipment inspection 
steps I1, which must be 
performed on a weekly basis 
as indicated by W1 in the title block.

A work permit must be issued 
 and the 
 qualified maintenance staff carry the suitable safety 
 ID category,

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,

items:
Use standard personal safety 
 and healthy
 equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 goggles, protective clothing, rubber gloves ... 
 etc
Don't smoke in the battery room.
Don't place any tools on top of battery cells (Danger of short circuit)

Inspect
 terminals of battery and clean any salt deposit with distilled water.

Clean
 dust from battery by using soft brush.

Check
 for correct position of all connections.

Clean
 battery room floor with water.

Check
 for correct operation of battery room exhaust (ventilation).
